profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at NextEra Analytics
profile.summary:
I’m a sports fanatic, fantasy football champion and dog lover with a passion for programming and computer science. 

I have professional experience building complex cloud native backend systems and microservice APIs using a variety of languages and frameworks: Python, Django, Django Rest Framework, Flask, JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js, Express, Java, SpringMVC, and Spring Boot. 

I have worked with relational and non-relational databases and data stores such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB, Elasticsearch and Redis. 

I have also built several custom front end single page apps (SPA) using both Angular 2x, React and React Native for mobile. 

I am AWS certified and have professional experience building CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, Gitlab Runner, Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS services such as EC2, S3, DynamoDB, RDS, Lambda (serverless), Step Functions, EventBridge, AppSync (GraphQL), API Gateway, ELB, CDK, CloudFormation, Elastic Beanstalk, IAM, CloudWatch, and X-Ray to name a few.

I'm very passionate about distributed computing and all things serverless. In my spare time I've been working on a fun intersection of two of my passions, sports and severless, check it out:
https://github.com/erictenenbaum/nfl-betting-serverless
https://github.com/erictenenbaum/nfl-betting-serverless-api-endpoint

I also enjoy teaching and sharing my passion for software development with others. I'm an adjunct instructor at Denver University and I tutor MERN Stack as well as Java Spring at various other universities across the country.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
I work on a team building backend distributed systems and REST APIs on AWS that power geospatial applications and services in the clean energy space. 

Technologies used: Python, Kotlin, AWS Lambda, StepFunctions, ECS, EventBridge, SQS, Aurora Serverless (Postgres with PostGIS), SQLAlchemy, Pydantic, DynamoDB, GeoJSON, ESRI data integration, SnapStart, Spring Boot, Docker, Terraform, Gitlab Runner
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · AWS Lambda · Terraform · Amazon ECS · Kotlin

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
I lead a team of engineers, half onshore and half offshore, building data products aimed at enhancing the fan experience and the overall broadcast capabilities of FOX Sports live game productions. We leverage AI/ML within a data-driven approach to solving sports media business problems with a focus on the predictive analysis of sporting events as well in-game plays. To that effect we are building a variety of web services as well as data engineering and platform capabilities all on AWS. 

Technologies used: Python, AWS Lambda, EventBridge, SQS, SNS, StepFunctions, Aurora Serverless (Postgres), DynamoDB, Aurora RDS (Postgres), ECS, Databricks and PySpark.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · AWS Lambda · AWS EventBridge · PostgreSQL · Serverless Framework · Serverless Computing · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Leading a team of engineers building building REST APIs and event driven distributed systems using TypeScript/Node.js, Python, AWS Serverless technologies and the Serverless Framework. 

Some of our projects include:
Developed a REST API for a fitness class scheduling system
• Designed a DynamoDB Table using Single Table Design principles
• Configured Primary Keys and Global Secondary Indexes
• Created CloudFormation Template to provision this resource
• Created serverless.yml file to provision and configure Lambda handlers backed by API
       Gateway.

Developed a REST API for user entitlements using RDS (MySQL)

Worked on an Enterprise Message Bus using SQS, SNS and Lambda to consume DynamoDB streams, EventBridge Cron Jobs, AppSync (GraphQL), and other events to publish messages to:
• A Data Reindexing Service using Algolia
• An Email and SMS Service used to remind class participants of upcoming classes or
   notify them in the event of an update to their class details
• Monitor class participant count and live user metrics
• Data Analytics Service
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · AWS Lambda · Node.js · TypeScript · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Amazon Dynamodb

positions.title: Adjunct Instructor
positions.description:
*Now in a substitute capacity

I am an instructor for the Denver University Full Stack Web Development Bootcamp. The languages and technologies I teach include:

HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Node.js, Express, Middleware, REST APIs, Git, MySQL, MongoDB, Firebase, Sequelize.js, Mongoose, React, React Hooks, and Computer Science Fundamentals.

positions.title: Software Development Team Lead
positions.description:
I was promoted to lead an international team of full stack engineers to build cross-platform native mobile and responsive web applications using React Native and GraphQL, aimed at providing a unified experience for all users regardless of platform.

I lead refinement sessions with the development team to break down feature work into composable, well-defined user stories with clear acceptance criteria and fair story pointing.

Participate in Architecture and Design planning sessions with product managers, UX designers, scrum masters and architects. In these sessions we break apart broader goals and deliverables into organized and defined feature work.

Fierce advocate for my team. Work with my team to remove blockers and impediments, organize the work being done, clarify requirements, pair program and help with implementation details.

Helped lead the transition of the codebase to TypeScript from a Vanilla JavaScript.

Interface with a UK contingent of the development team working opposite hours.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Prior to being promoted to Team Lead, I worked on a data platform team using Python, Django, Django Rest Framework, PostgreSQL, and Docker to build cloud native RESTful APIs, backend services and data pipelines to support data science, machine learning and data analytics relating to agronomy and sustainability.

I also worked on an event driven distributed cloud system used to sync data in an eventually consistent manner across a multitude of disparate data stores (systems of record) both internal and external to the company. Just before being promoted, I worked on a proof of concept using the following AWS Services:  Lambda, Step Functions, EventBridge, AppSync (GraphQL), CDK, CloudFormation, IAM, CodePipeline, CloudWatch, and X-Ray

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Current Project:
Lead Backend Developer - 2019
I lead the backend development for two sister projects under the same management team. 

The first project I was one of the primary contributors to building a backend microservice system using Node.js, Express, Swagger and MongoDB. 

In the second project I am leading the re-write of a monolith into a microservices architecture using Typescript, Node.js, Express, Swagger, MongoDB and Elasticsearch in addition to building several additional microservices using Python, Flask and PostgreSQL and Elasticsearch. 

There is a lot of overlap between the two projects and I have the following responsibilities in both:

I assist the Software Development Manager with the Architecture and Design of our API ecosystem.

I lead the Cloud Development / DevOps effort
Containerizing and deploying our services and Angular Apps using Docker, Kubernetes and Helm 
Building a Jenkins CI/CD Pipeline to deploy to our AWS test environment and our client's OpenShift environment

Lead two ETL initiatives - schema design, external API integration, data transformation and data analytics - building DataFrames with Python, Pandas and Jupyter Notebooks
 
Helping Junior Developers through:
Pair Programming
Code Reviews before pull requests get merged
Assignment of JIRA tickets
Built internal libraries and tools

Previous projects:
Front End Developer - 2019 
I worked part time on a data visualization dashboard app to help Deloitte land a new contract. This was a great opportunity to keep my front end skills up and work on an Angular application.

Java Developer - 2018
I built microservice APIs using Java, Spring Boot and PostgreSQL for an Enterprise Healthcare System

Technologies used: Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js, Express.js, Python, Pandas, Jupyter Notebooks, Angular, Spring Boot, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch,  JSON, YAML, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, NGINX

positions.title: Senior Tutor - Full Stack Web Development
positions.description:
Teaching students at various Universities across the nation Full-Stack software development skills through one-on-one tutoring sessions.

Technologies Taught: (MERN & SERN STACK) HTML, Git, CSS, Bootstrap, JavaScript(Beginner to Advanced), jQuery, Firebase, nodeJS, mySQL, Express, Handlebars, MVC, Sequelize, Test Driven Development, MongoDB, mongoose, React, Java, Computer Science Fundamentals.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant for the University of Arizona Coding Bootcamp
positions.description:
Assist in teaching full stack web development at the University of Arizona Coding Bootcamp. The languages and technologies in which I teach include:

HTML, CSS, Javascript, jQuery, AJAX, REST, Bootstrap, Git, Command Line tools, API's, Firebase, MySQL, mongoDB, Handlebars.js, Java, Sequelize.js, Mongoose, MERN Stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js), and more.
